title: Editor materials
summary: Editor, Inventory, Files and Terminal for carrying text, commands and file places.
task: Carry a selection, a Terminal command and a file place into Inventory folders, then bring them back.
choose: you want the Editor carrying story, optionally with the Neovim-backed Editor.
prepares: Editor, Inventory, Files, Terminal and the Demo controls

first_task.do: Run `workshop/editor-materials-demo` with phase=prepare (its README names the inputs).
first_task.expect: The carried materials are filed in folders and saved as a toolbox.

limits: The story writes beat.cpp and notes.txt under the root's workshop/materials

reset.keeps: every Inventory entry and every file
